documents.name: Shiroi Koibito Park
documents.summary: A confectionery theme park that earns attraction status through make-your-own sweets, designed factory storytelling and playful indoor/outdoor environments rather than the brand shop alone.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A very good, easy-to-use Sapporo attraction for families and confectionery fans. It remains brand-heavy, workshops cost extra and production-line visibility can vary with operations, so it is a meaningful detour rather than a Japan-trip anchor.

audience.notes: Preschool and primary-school children are especially well served; hands-on workshop participation depends on the selected course and booking availability.

coverImage.alt: Ishiya Chocolate Factory buildings at Shiroi Koibito Park in Sapporo.

documents.name: Miyajimanuma Goose Roost Departure
documents.localName: 宮島沼のマガンねぐら立ち
documents.summary: A small Hokkaido wetland that can become extraordinary when tens of thousands of greater white-fronted geese leave or return to the communal roost around dawn and dusk.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Major-detour worthwhile during the migration peak, usually mid-to-late April and late September to early October. Outside migration it should not consume scarce national travel time. Observe only from designated areas and follow local wildlife guidance.

legacy-effort-required.label: Effort required
legacy-effort-required.note: Easy physical access but high timing discipline: arrive for dawn or dusk in the migration window and observe only from designated areas.

coverImage.alt: A large flock of waterbirds over Miyajimanuma during spring migration.

documents.name: Kyodogakusha Shintoku Farm Mintal
documents.localName: 共働学舎新得農場 ミンタル
documents.summary: One of Japan’s most compelling farm-cheese destinations, pairing internationally respected natural-rind cheeses with the place and animals that produce them.
documents.whyWorthwhile: This is destination-worthy even for travellers who normally ignore farm shops: the products are distinctive, technically serious and difficult to experience as completely elsewhere.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Rural seasonal schedules and product availability vary; confirm the shop calendar.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Spring–autumn for the fullest farm context; cheese itself is worthwhile year-round.

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Some English support may exist; Japanese information predominates.

legacy-reservation-requirement.label: Reservation requirement
legacy-reservation-requirement.note: Usually not required for shop/café; special activities may require advance contact

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Current methods should be checked; cards are likely but not assumed.

documents.name: Ban’ei Tokachi Draft-Horse Racing
documents.summary: Obihiro’s globally unusual heavy-sled horse racing, where massive draft horses pull weighted sleds over sand obstacles.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The racing format is genuinely distinctive and deeply associated with Tokachi, making a race meeting a worthwhile specialist stop that cannot be replicated at a conventional Japanese racecourse.

booking.note: Normal admission or public viewing does not require advance booking, although busy dates may still reward planning.

coreExperience.note: Japanese adds context, but the core visitor experience remains understandable with limited Japanese and translation support.

constraint.label: Material constraint
constraint.note: The core spectacle is brief within a conventional racecourse visit, and animal-welfare concerns materially limit an unqualified recommendation.

visit-window.note: Race dates are scheduled rather than daily; visit only when a meeting is confirmed.

documents.name: Nikka Whisky Yoichi Distillery
documents.localName: ニッカウヰスキー余市蒸溜所
documents.summary: A rare chance to understand Japanese whisky through a historically intact coastal distillery where process, architecture and climate remain visible.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Even visitors who know Japanese whisky mainly through scarce bottles gain a much more grounded understanding here; the official tour is unusually strong value.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Tour availability and tasting lineup change; reserve only through the official system.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Year-round; winter adds atmosphere but weather can disrupt travel.

legacy-car-usefulness.label: Car usefulness
legacy-car-usefulness.note: Not useful if tasting; rail is preferable

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: Age and driving restrictions apply to alcohol tasting; bring identification.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Tour may be free; shop/tasting payment methods shown on site.

documents.name: Kokoro no Resort Umi no Bettei Furukawa
documents.localName: 心のリゾート 海の別邸ふる川
documents.summary: Few room baths place a couple this directly above the open Pacific, especially at sunrise or during severe winter seas.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Few room baths place a couple this directly above the open Pacific, especially at sunrise or during severe winter seas.
cardSignals: Two: Approximately ¥122,000–272,000 total for two with dinner and breakfast in qualifying suites.

legacy-important-caveats.label: Important caveats
legacy-important-caveats.note: Only suites 201/202 qualify; treatment details are unclear and adjacent-terrace privacy is not equivalent to detachment.

documents.name: Ryugetsu Sweetpia Garden
documents.localName: 柳月スイートピア・ガーデン
documents.summary: A well-designed confectionery factory stop where production viewing, fresh cake and Tokachi ingredients form a coherent experience.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The stop offers unusually good value for families or confectionery enthusiasts and pairs naturally with other Tokachi dairy destinations.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Production viewing may not run continuously; confirm factory and café schedules.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Year-round; arrive early if seeking limited factory products.

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Some visitor information likely; Japanese predominates.

legacy-reservation-requirement.label: Reservation requirement
legacy-reservation-requirement.note: Walk-in; special classes may require booking

legacy-reservation-method.label: Reservation method
legacy-reservation-method.note: Official website / direct reservation for activities

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

documents.name: Kakizaki Shoten Kaisen Kobo
documents.localName: 柿崎商店 海鮮工房
documents.summary: A fishmonger’s upstairs canteen where Hokkaidō seafood is served with unusually little distance between wholesale counter and bowl.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The attraction is not refinement: it is access to strong raw material at a price and breadth difficult to reproduce in an ordinary city restaurant.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Current official/local listing checked; seafood and hours can vary, and popular items can sell out.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Best when local uni and salmon roe are in season; worthwhile year-round.

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Limited/unclear; display photos and translation should suffice.

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Cash is safest; current cashless acceptance should be rechecked.

documents.name: Ginneko
documents.summary: A single bird preparation—roasted over charcoal and lacquered with a long-used tare—functions as an unusually durable local dish rather than generic yakitori.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Its strongest decision-relevant feature is access to Asahikawa's half-chicken charcoal-roasted 'shinkoyaki'. The recommended visit is: Reserve one shinkoyaki per suitable group and add a few skewers rather than over-ordering.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Small shop; evening waits and sell-outs are possible.

documents.name: Zaborin
documents.summary: Detached architecture, primeval forest and deep snow combine with 100% self-source kakenagashi water.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Detached architecture, primeval forest and deep snow combine with 100% self-source kakenagashi water.
cardSignals: Two: Approximately ¥180,000–300,000+ total for two with dinner and breakfast.

legacy-reservation-model.label: Reservation model
legacy-reservation-model.note: Private outdoor bath is guaranteed in every room.

legacy-important-caveats.label: Important caveats
legacy-important-caveats.note: Very expensive, especially during ski and holiday peaks; room tub and view angle vary.

documents.name: Uryūnuma Wetland Circuit
documents.summary: A real mountain approach opens abruptly into a broad high moor of pools, winding channels and boardwalk, making the wetland feel far larger than a roadside marsh.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The transition from enclosed forest climb to a wide, elevated moor is the experience. Flower season and September autumn grass both give the pools and mountain enclosure enough scale to justify a dedicated detour.

coverImage.alt: Documentary photograph of Uryunuma Wetland, representative of Uryūnuma Wetland Circuit.

documents.name: Hakodate Morning Market
documents.summary: A dense, active morning market where visitors can compare seafood counters, breakfasts and specialist stalls rather than committing to one famous restaurant.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Its value lies in comparative browsing, breakfast timing and breadth rather than any single compulsory shop.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Individual businesses keep different days and many close by early afternoon.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Early morning; squid availability and species vary by season.

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Mixed; carry cash because small vendors vary.

coverImage.alt: Documentary photograph of Hakodate Morning Market.

documents.name: Marutoma Shokudo
documents.summary: A working-port canteen that turns Tomakomai’s surf-clam identity into an exuberant menu, especially its hokki curry.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The combination of regional ingredient, working-port context and very low meal price justifies the queue.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Early/lunch-oriented service; closures and sell-outs occur, so check the official site immediately before travel.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Year-round; weekday mornings offer the best queue-to-payoff ratio.

legacy-ordering-difficulty.label: Ordering / language friction
legacy-ordering-difficulty.note: Preparation required because of queues, handwritten specials and fast turnover.

legacy-public-transport.label: Public transport practicality
legacy-public-transport.note: Possible but less convenient than driving

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

documents.name: Rokkatei Obihiro Main Store
documents.summary: The home-city flagship of a confectioner that expresses Tokachi dairy, beans and flour more convincingly than a generic souvenir shop.
documents.whyWorthwhile: It is a polished but still food-led window into Hokkaidō confectionery ingredients and product development.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Current tourism listing checked; café last orders may precede shop closing.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Year-round; seasonal fresh sweets add value.

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Usually manageable; product packaging often includes Roman letters.

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; confirm current house policy.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Major cashless methods likely; verify current branch policy.

documents.name: Poronno
documents.localName: 民芸喫茶 ポロンノ
documents.summary: A rare independent place where a traveller can eat several Ainu-derived dishes in the cultural landscape of Akan Kotan rather than at a generic regional restaurant.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Its strongest decision-relevant feature is access to Visitor-accessible Ainu dishes in Akan Kotan. The recommended visit is: Choose a small spread of dishes rather than treating one item as representative of Ainu cuisine.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Seasonal operation and irregular closing days are possible; verify immediately before travel.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Summer to early autumn; lunch hours

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Reported available in prior official material; verify current version

legacy-reservation-requirement.label: Reservation requirement
legacy-reservation-requirement.note: Reservation recommended for a special-purpose visit

legacy-public-transport.label: Public transport practicality
legacy-public-transport.note: Manageable by bus within Akan; regional access is slow

legacy-car-usefulness.label: Car usefulness
legacy-car-usefulness.note: Useful but not essential; Akan is remote

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: Respect any house guidance on cultural interpretation and photography.

documents.name: Takinoya
documents.localName: 登別温泉郷 滝乃家
documents.summary: Water quality, garden craft, restrained architecture and strong cuisine work together rather than relying on suite size alone.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Water quality, garden craft, restrained architecture and strong cuisine work together rather than relying on suite size alone.
cardSignals: Two: Approximately ¥100,000–160,000 total for two in qualifying outdoor bath rooms with dinner and breakfast.

legacy-reservation-model.label: Reservation model
legacy-reservation-model.note: Book only a room category explicitly carrying a source-fed outdoor bath.

legacy-important-caveats.label: Important caveats
legacy-important-caveats.note: Eligibility is room-specific and the natural view is garden-framed rather than a broad wilderness panorama.

documents.name: Akkeshi Gourmet Park Conchiglie
documents.localName: 道の駅 厚岸グルメパーク 厚岸味覚ターミナル コンキリエ
documents.summary: An unusually complete Akkeshi-oyster destination combining specialist counters, charcoal self-grilling, retail and access to the local whisky-distillery tour.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The breadth lets a traveller compare raw, grilled and cooked oysters in the producing town rather than treating Akkeshi as a name on a menu elsewhere.

legacy-opening-season.label: Opening / seasonal considerations
legacy-opening-season.note: Current August 2026 notices confirm operation, but outlet hours, closure days and activity calendars differ; check the official calendar.

legacy-best-timing.label: Best timing
legacy-best-timing.note: Year-round for oysters; reserve distillery tours as soon as their seasonal booking window opens.

legacy-english-menu.label: English menu
legacy-english-menu.note: Visitor-facing facility; some pictorial or English support is likely, but not verified for every outlet.

legacy-reservation-requirement.label: Reservation requirement
legacy-reservation-requirement.note: Walk-in for food; advance reservation required for selected activities

legacy-reservation-method.label: Reservation method
legacy-reservation-method.note: Official website for activities; restaurants normally accept walk-ins

legacy-visit-duration.label: Visit duration
legacy-visit-duration.note: 1.5–3 hours; longer with a distillery tour

legacy-public-transport.label: Public transport practicality
legacy-public-transport.note: Practical: about eight minutes on foot from Akkeshi Station

legacy-important-rules.label: Important rules
legacy-important-rules.note: No unusual rule verified; reconfirm any house rules before visiting.

legacy-payment-limitations.label: Payment limitations
legacy-payment-limitations.note: Payment methods vary by outlet; carry cash as backup.

documents.name: Shikotsu Lake Tsuruga Bessou Ao no Za
documents.localName: しこつ湖 鶴雅別荘 碧の座
documents.summary: A genuinely large private bath faces one of Hokkaido’s most beautiful caldera lakes.
documents.whyWorthwhile: A genuinely large private bath faces one of Hokkaido’s most beautiful caldera lakes.
cardSignals: Two: Approximately ¥141,000–218,000 total for two with dinner and breakfast.

legacy-reservation-model.label: Reservation model
legacy-reservation-model.note: Private outdoor onsen is guaranteed in every suite.

legacy-important-caveats.label: Important caveats
legacy-important-caveats.note: The room baths are explicitly circulated, filtered and chlorine-disinfected, so this is not kakenagashi despite the scenery.

documents.name: Lake Akan Ainu Cultural Cluster
documents.localName: 阿寒湖アイヌコタン・ロストカムイルミナ
documents.summary: A lakeside cluster combining Ainu dance, theatre, craft culture and a story-led forest night walk around Akanko Ainu Kotan.
documents.whyWorthwhile: The combination is stronger than any single component: traditional and contemporary Ainu performance, crafts and the Kamuy Lumina night walk make Lake Akan a substantial cultural evening rather than a brief folklore stop.

visualSignals.label: Experience
visualSignals.value: Ainu cultural experience · live dance and digital performance

booking.note: Advance planning or reservation is recommended because capacity, crowds or component schedules can affect the visit.

coreExperience.note: Japanese adds context, but the core visitor experience remains understandable with limited Japanese and translation support.

constraint.label: Material constraint
constraint.note: Individual components are relatively short and the visitor-facing district has a noticeable commercial layer, so the strongest visit comes from combining several experiences rather than treating one show as the whole product.

visit-window.note: Night programmes and performance schedules vary by season; confirm both before travelling.
